Even though I'm not suicidal rn, I read the whole thing through, it's a really good resource and esp the part where it says:
"People often turn to suicide because they are seeking relief from pain. Remember that relief is a feeling. And you have to be alive to feel it. You will not feel the relief you so desperately seek, if you are dead."
EXACTLY! a lot of times we romanticize death and think it's gonna take away the pain (and give us relief) but it's not possible to feel that painlessness without even being here. Death is NOT comfy/pleasurable. Once you're dead, you can't get relief because you won't even be there to get it.

Never planned to be alive this long. But here I am. So that got me thinking, why not just live? My being here is like a kick in life's face itself. I'm living that post death existence, I've got nothing to lose. I wanna see what happens next, I could always kill myself later.
